note: The cases this repository's own server fails today. Each names a route or a rule of the API design that is not built yet; the case stays as it is and the gap is closed in the server. A declared case that passes fails the run, so a line here cannot outlive its gap.

cases.case003ContentTypes: the decoder takes application/json only; a YAML body is refused with unsupported_media_type
cases.case008NotAcceptable: no content negotiation: an Accept that excludes JSON and YAML is answered in JSON instead of 406
cases.case008NameOnPathAndBody: PUT /v1/sandboxes/{name} is not served, so apply by name and its name rule have no route
cases.case008ExecStream: POST .../exec without wait=1 is refused; the framed exec stream is not served
cases.case008PublicDocuments: /openapi.yaml is not generated or served; the key set is
cases.case009ObjectFeed: GET /v1/events is not served; the journal reaches the operator's sink only
cases.case004CapabilityGates: the dial route is not registered, so an environment without Dial answers 404 rather than the gate's 422
